notes.notes: Added a new winner to the championship match.

notes.title: ver 1.71
notes.notes: Added a new winner to the championship match.

notes.title: Ver 1.52
notes.notes:
- Magic Item added.
- Territorial War: Unlock up to 1300%.

notes.title: Ver 1.50
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.50>
- Settings: Added Aide automatic selection [OFF/alternating/random].
- Added Skill Reduction.
 (Magic items can be strengthened using monsters whose skills have been strengthened to the maximum)
- Additional special equipment. (2 types)
- Territory war loop processing. (up to halfway)

notes.title: Ver1.46
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.46>
- PAD operation: Changed the speed up button in HorusEye to L button. (Previous L2 is also valid)
- Fixed a bug where the curse effect was not applied to Setsuna.
- Fixed area generation process.
- Territorial War +20%

notes.title: ver 1.45
notes.notes:
[Ver 1.45]
- Added attack value details to hint.
- Tweaked damage calculation.
- Corrected the process when leaving cores without enough Velis.
- Added race icon. Added help to the monster details screen.
- Unified Dragon kill to Dragon Slayer.
- Changed the range of Dragon Slayer: "Dragon tribe (sacred beasts and dragons)" & "Heavy".
- If the territory is 100% or more, the area level will also be displayed when selecting a mercenary in the hunting ground.
- The total number of soldiers is also displayed on the Horus eye.
- Corrected the number of uncleared items when there is no castle.
- Added speed up button in Horus eye when additional information display is ON in settings.
- Added a new winner to the championship.
- Added the history of the creation of races to the world.

notes.title: Winning Battalion Battle
notes.notes:
Added the ability to fight against past “official tournament winning battalions”!
You get rewards for winning.

<Ver 1.43>
- Compete against the winning battalion of the official tournament. (Unlocked with 20 or more wins)
- Relaxed the conditions for Demon world of merchant to appear.
(There is a possibility of it appearing if Velis is less than 900,000)
- Positively adjusted Hell Wraith's attack range.

notes.title: Ver1.41B
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.41B>
- PC version) Added scs script sample to scs folder: Play by pressing 1 key etc. during the game.
- Fixed so that it is not possible to equip more than one special equipment.
- Settings: Additional information display ON/OFF
- Added detailed information to the base screen.
- Display system correction.
- Further relaxed Zavak's SQ-Lv limit.
- Automatically change List to Skill after opening "Priority Skill" during Zvald.
- Added help for "Priority Skills".

notes.title: Ver 1.38
notes.notes:
- Corrected resistance value display during battle. (internal data is correct)
- Added initialization process for company equipment. (Corrected equipment when splitting slime)
- Territory war +20%

notes.title: Ver 1.37
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.37>
- Unlock up to SoulQuality Lv.96.
- Territorial battle +60%
- Added new kingdom "GIEEVAL".
- Increased the area completion bonus for Zavak and GIEEVAL by several times.
- Zavak and GIEEVAL annihilation bonus increased.
- It is stated that light radiation has Magic attribute.
- Circle of the Truth melee range +10px.
- Fixed an issue where the main skill levels were not reflected except for some.
- Process to re-contract with all mercenary groups whose contracts have expired (Zavak and later).
- New Ex.Ability curse guard set for aides and God types.
- Changed main skill & magic gear Aura shield S (maximum reduction 100%) to Aura shield H (maximum reduction 90%).
etc.

notes.title: Ver1.36
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.36>
-Fixed a crash on the title screen due to a too fast CPU.

notes.title: Ver 1.35
notes.notes:
<Ver 1.35>
- Fixed a bug where Alvia's HP and SP increased.
- Fixed attribute value display during Zvald.
- Settings: Simplify the battle result screen ON/OFF
- Territorial battle +60%
- Corrected the maximum summoning rate during siege for SQ-Lv45 and above.
